name: Modal
description: Display a modal dialog box, providing a title, content area, and action buttons.

props.name: afterClose
props.description: Specify a function that will be called when modal is closed completely
props.descriptionZh: Modal 完全关闭后的回调

props.name: afterOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the animation ends when Modal is turned on and off
props.descriptionZh: 打开和关闭 Modal 时动画结束后的回调

props.name: classes
props.description: Customize class for each semantic structure inside the Modal component. Supports object or function.
props.descriptionZh: 用于自定义 Modal 组件内部各语义化结构的 class，支持对象或函数

props.name: closable
props.description: Whether a close (x) button is visible on top right or not
props.descriptionZh: 是否显示右上角的关闭按钮

props.name: closeIcon
props.description: Custom close icon. Close button will be hidden when setting to `null` or `false`
props.descriptionZh: 自定义关闭图标。设置为 `null` 或 `false` 时隐藏关闭按钮

props.name: confirmLoading
props.description: Whether to apply loading visual effect for OK button or not

props.name: destroyOnHidden
props.description: Whether to unmount child components on close
props.descriptionZh: 关闭时销毁 Modal 里的子元素

props.name: focusTriggerAfterClose
props.description: Whether need to focus trigger element after dialog is closed
props.descriptionZh: 对话框关闭后是否需要聚焦触发元素

props.name: footer
props.type: VueNode \| (params: { originNode: VueNode, extra: { OkBtn: any, CancelBtn: any } }) => any
props.description: Footer content, set as `footer={null}` when you don't need default buttons
props.descriptionZh: 底部内容，当不需要默认底部按钮时，可以设为 `footer={null}`

props.name: focusable
props.description: Configuration for focus management in the Modal
props.descriptionZh: 对话框内焦点管理的配置

props.name: getContainer
props.description: The mounted node for Modal but still display at fullscreen
props.descriptionZh: 指定 Modal 挂载的节点，但依旧为全屏展示，`false` 为挂载在当前位置

props.name: keyboard
props.description: Whether support press esc to close
props.descriptionZh: 是否支持键盘 esc 关闭

props.name: mask
props.type: boolean \| `{enabled?: boolean, blur?: boolean, closable?: boolean}`

props.name: ~~maskClosable~~
props.description: Whether to close the modal dialog when the mask (area outside the modal) is clicked

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the modal dialog is visible or not, support `v-model:open`

props.name: scrollLock
props.description: Whether to lock body scroll when modal opens
props.descriptionZh: 弹窗打开时是否锁定 body 滚动

props.name: styles
props.description: Customize inline style for each semantic structure inside the Modal component. Supports object or function.
props.descriptionZh: 用于自定义 Modal 组件内部各语义化结构的行内 style，支持对象或函数

props.name: wrapClassName
props.description: The class name of the container of the modal dialog
props.descriptionZh: 对话框外层容器的类名

props.name: maskClosable
props.descriptionZh: 点击蒙层是否允许关闭

events.name: ok
events.description: Callback when the OK button is clicked

events.name: cancel
events.description: Callback when the mask, close button or Cancel button is clicked
events.descriptionZh: 点击遮罩层或右上角叉或取消按钮的回调

slots.name: footer
slots.type: (params: { originNode: VueNode, extra: { OkBtn: any, CancelBtn: any } }) => any

properties.descriptionZh: 是否显示右上角的关闭按钮

properties.descriptionZh: 可用于设置浮层的样式，调整浮层位置等

properties.descriptionZh: 对话框外层容器的类名

properties.name: onCancel

properties.descriptionZh: 点击取消回调，参数为关闭函数

properties.name: onOk
properties.description: Click to onOk callback, the parameter is the closing function
properties.descriptionZh: 点击确定回调，参数为关闭函数

commonProps.name: rootClass
commonProps.descriptionZh: 添加在组件最外层的 className

commonProps.name: autoFocus
commonProps.description: Auto focus when component mounted, only effective for focusable elements like forms, links, etc.
commonProps.descriptionZh: 自动获取焦点，仅对表单类、链接、交互容器等可聚焦元素生效
